agentNotes: Authoring contract: frontend/AGENTS.md §9 (extra unit card). Exam bank: 50 m/37-degree components (2024), dot-vs-cross definitions (2023).

card.title: Exam bank — every board question on vectors

rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Two questions: rectangular components of 50 m at 37 degrees (2024: 40 i + 30 j) and dot-vs-cross definitions with one physics example each (2023). Dot measures sameness (projection, scalar); cross measures perpendicularity (area, vector). Resolution (Ax = A cos, Ay = A sin) precedes both products.

rows.label: Formula
rows.text: Ax = A cos theta, Ay = A sin theta · A.B = AB cos (scalar) · |AxB| = AB sin n-hat (vector) · 50 at 37 deg: 40, 30 (3-4-5 triangle)

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: Resolution needs the angle from a stated axis (meaning 37 degrees from +x fixes Ax = A cos). Dot/cross angle measured tail-to-tail. Unit-vector form needs orthonormal i, j, k.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: 37 degrees signals 3-4-5: 50 x 0.8 = 40, 50 x 0.6 = 30 (no calculator sweat). Dot examples: work, flux; cross examples: torque, magnetic force. Parallel gives cross zero; perpendicular gives max AB.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: NEB 2024 (3): Ax = 50 cos37 ~ 40 m, Ay = 50 sin37 ~ 30 m. NEB 2023 (3): dot = AB cos (scalar, e.g. work) vs cross = AB sin n-hat (vector, e.g. torque) — definition plus one example each.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: Mark-losers: sine/cosine swapped (draw the triangle first); cross treated as scalar; 2D pseudo-cross claimed as true cross product. Products need the tail-to-tail angle, not polygon interiors.

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: Component proof via right-triangle projection; dot via cosine rule (algebra meets geometry); cross magnitude as parallelogram area. Triangle/parallelogram/polygon laws derive from tip-to-tail chaining.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: 37/53 degrees means 3-4-5 scaling (30-40-50 here). 'Define both products' means formula plus type (scalar/vector) plus one example each. Resolution before products, always.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: NEB 2024 (3): 50 m at 37 degrees components. NEB 2023 (3): dot vs cross definitions + examples. That is the complete bank.
